name: Yonamine Jun
source:
Her tanned skin radiates vitality. Appears like a bullet - diving into the sea or tackling people without warning - almost never making a normal entrance. A pure-hearted girl who dearly loves her home, Hoshimi Island.
[Translated from Japanese by DeepSeek]
